title: SLO Initiative Sprint-Bridge & Dependency Graph
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Build a lightweight ‘sprint-bridge’ for SLO initiatives that links initiative tickets to sprint-level tasks and produces a live dependency graph. Aim: shorten lead time from SLO detection to mitigation by surfacing ownership, blocking services, and error-budget runway per initiative in a single view.
background: We have many reliability initiatives spread across teams and quarters. Current trackers emphasize long-term runway and error-budget allocations but lack sprint-level visibility or an automated dependency graph. This makes on-call and PMs slow to form mitigation plans when SLI drift occurs. Existing initiative trackers (error-budget playbooks) are high-level; this ticket aims to create the bridge between those artifacts and sprint execution.
goals: 1) Create a standardized mapping of initiative -> sprint stories -> owners. 2) Auto-generate a dependency graph showing services, models, and infra components tied to each initiative. 3) Surface real-time error-budget runway and SLI trend next to each node. 4) Provide playbook links and rollback criteria per initiative.
scope_in_scope:
- Define sprint-bridge data model (initiative, owner, sprint ticket refs, service nodes)
- Basic UI in the Initiatives dashboard to render a graph
- Integrations: Linear (tickets), telemetry service for SLI values, Console for links
- Exportable CSV of affected services and owners for incident handoff
out_of_scope:
- Full visualization overhaul of the Console dashboards
- Automatic remediation (runbooks will be links only)
- Deep graph analytics beyond immediate dependencies
metrics:
- Time from SLI drift alert to mitigation ticket creation (target < 6 hours)
- Percentage of reliability incidents with a sprint-bridge created within 24 hours (target 90%)
- Error budget runway visibility coverage for top-8 product initiatives (target 100%)
acceptance_criteria:
- A new Initiatives view exposes sprint-bridge rows and a dependency graph for at least 5 pilot initiatives.
- Each graph node displays current SLI (last 24h), error-budget runway, and owner contact.
- Graph updates when Linear sprint tickets are moved between states.
- Docs and one-run training session completed with SRE and Platform PMs.
implementation_notes:
- Data model will be a lightweight mapping stored in the Initiatives service (keyed by PM- id).
- Use telemetry API to fetch SLI summaries; cache for 5 minutes.
- Graph rendering with existing Console components to avoid new frontend infra.
- Fall back to a tabular export when graph fails to load.
rollout_plan: Week 1: design data model + API contracts. Week 2: backend mapping and telemetry queries. Week 3: wire UI prototype with 3 pilot initiatives. Week 4: iterate on feedback, docs, and launch to all reliability initiatives. Post-launch: 2-week observation window with SRE on-call rotation.
monitoring_playbook: Include quick links to: error-budget ledger, SLI trend, incident runbook, and a one-click create-mitigation-ticket flow. Define thresholds that trigger suggested mitigation templates (e.g., 3% SLI drop over 1h).

risks:
- Telemetry sampling may cause noisy SLI signals in graphs.
- Overhead of maintaining mappings if not automated; need minimal manual inputs.
- Cross-team alignment risk: some teams may not expose required service metadata.
next_steps: 1) Sync with SRE on 2026-02-24 to validate SLI endpoints. 2) Draft data model and share for review. 3) Identify 5 pilot initiatives for Q2. 4) Create ENG- / DES- tickets for implementation after design sign-off.
